result.title: TopoField: Technical Report for ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge
result.comment: Technical Report for ECCV OpenSUN3D Workshop SceneFun3D Benchmark Challenge
result.summary: Functional segmentation requires locating small interactive parts, such as knobs, buttons, and sockets, in indoor point clouds and returning confidence-ranked instance masks. A point-wise semantic predictor produces a continuous probability field, whereas the benchmark evaluates a discrete set of scored instances. This creates a substantial field-to-instance gap. We present TopoField, a deterministic decoder built on top of VOLT. TopoField first converts 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field, then decodes instance candidates from the consensus geometry, and finally ranks the candidates in a class-aware manner. The augmentation stage retains the processed-point identity of every fragment prediction, accumulates probabilities in a common point array, normalizes by coverage count, and fuses the resulting caches. The decoding stage separates high-confidence cores from broader support regions, constructs a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and uses a multi-source graph-geodesic partition to split support regions that contain multiple seeds. On 561 ground-truth instances across 30 validation scenes, an IoU-0.5-valid candidate exists for 67.2% of instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary measurements motivate joint attention to candidate construction and ranking. TopoField achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP50, and 47.558% AP25. TopoField achieved second place on the ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告提出 TopoField，用于室内点云的功能部件分割：将多次前向预测融合为语义一致场，再基于图测地分区解码实例并对候选按类排序。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 3D 点云分割的挑战赛工程方案，只涉及静态概率场到实例的后处理与排序，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，缺乏可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
